context: Guards that the Step 4g header logo-size check reads the ACTUAL header.css rule and flags a fixed-width regression, rather than asserting from documentation that the shared rule already uses max-height. Fixture header.css has the regressed fixed-width rule; the agent must detect and fix it.

checklist.name: Identifies the fixed-width regression from the actual file
checklist.description: The agent reads blocks/header/header.css and states that the brand-logo rule uses a fixed width + height:auto with no max-height — a header logo-size FAIL. It does not claim the rule already uses max-height.

checklist.name: Fixes the shared rule to use max-height
checklist.description: blocks/header/header.css now constrains the brand-logo rule by max-height against --nav-bar-height (not a bare fixed width).

checklist.name: Does not add a per-company override selector
checklist.description: The fix does not introduce a brand-specific selector (e.g. .icon-volkswagen-icon) sized in pixels.

checklist.name: Does not assume the doc's claimed state
checklist.description: The agent does not assert that the template already constrains the logo by max-height without checking the file — it verifies against the tree.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal terms are surfaced unnecessarily to the customer (I1).
